notes: Sprinting can now look like running instead of a bolt-upright body sliding across the ground. It is an opt-in preview: set WAR_RUN_CYCLE=1 before launch. The walk preview keeps its own switch, WAR_WALK_CYCLE=1, so turning one on never turns on the other.

The run is its own movement rather than the walk sped up — the arms fold and drive, and the knees stay bent the way they do when someone is really running. It covers more ground per stride, so going faster reads as longer, harder strides instead of quicker little steps.
Two rough edges remain: switching between walking and running snaps rather than easing, and jumping still has no movement of its own, so the body settles back to standing in the air.
title: Sprinting can look like running
